name: com.mikeye/mikeye
title: Mike Ye M&A Library
description: Free M&A library: deal checklists, valuation models and exit-readiness frameworks.

tools.name: my.origin.getIdentity
tools.description: Returns the canonical identity of Mike Ye — origin node of the eight-domain ecosystem — including identity profiles and affiliated entities.

tools.name: my.strategy.getDoctrine
tools.description: Returns the Decision Framing doctrine: purpose, structure, and the five decision frames it comprises.

tools.name: my.frames.get
tools.description: Returns the five decision frames (Judgment-as-a-Service, Dependency vs Leverage, Timing Asymmetry, Signal vs Narrative, Scarcity vs Growth). Optionally filter by name or category.

name.description: Filter by frame name (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.name: my.exit.getFramework
tools.description: Returns the Buyer-Lens Audit™ v1.0 framework: six evaluation dimensions, what each evaluates, provenance, and the two-tier delivery model ($199 Main Street / $499 Full Report).

tools.name: my.exit.runDiagnostic
tools.description: Returns the structure of the free 8-question Exit Readiness Assessment, tier-routing logic, and the execution URL. The interactive diagnostic runs at mikeye.com/exit/score.

tools.name: my.glossary.lookup
tools.description: Look up an M&A or exit term from the Exit Desk Glossary — 54 owner-facing definitions authored by Mike Ye. Pass a term to get its definition, category, and the canonical mikeye.com URL where the full seller-implication and buyer-perspective for that term live. Omit the term to list all available terms by category.

term.description: The term to look up (case-insensitive; matches term name or slug, partial allowed)

category.description: Optional filter: one of 'The Money', 'The Mechanics', 'The People', 'The Process', 'The Frameworks'

tools.name: my.library.findTool
tools.description: Describe a need in plain words (for example 'due diligence checklist', 'structure an earnout', 'post-merger integration plan', 'comparable company analysis template') and get the best-matching free Mike Ye M&A tool, checklist, template or valuation model, with its guide page and direct Excel download. All downloads are free, need no sign-up and contain no macros. Omit need to list every common need and its tool.

need.description: What the user is trying to do, in plain words

tools.name: my.dataset.get
tools.description: Returns a named dataset from the mikeye.com origin node. ma_library provides metadata for all 24 published resources (deal tools, checklists, templates, valuation and merger models, cases and frameworks), free download links, and the seven-stage transaction path; ontology distinguishes ordered stages from M&A knowledge pillars. This tool returns reference data and does not execute spreadsheet calculations. Valid names: origin, doctrine, decision_frames, strategy, ecosystem, glossary, keywords, ma_library, ontology.
